verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a company-formation and compliance SaaS, so a public API reference is a fair thing to ask about. The pack contains no evidence of an interactive API reference or runnable examples. The only API mention is a pricing-page line, "Advanced API integrations," which describes a service feature rather than developer documentation. Probes for OpenAPI and Swagger specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
